Hi Elena,

Thanks — received the PO. We can support a mid-cycle add-on and will issue a revised invoice showing the prorated charge for the remainder of this billing period (4–30 July). To confirm the process:

- We will calculate a prorated fee for the 10 seats for the remaining billing days and either issue a short-period invoice (net charge) or post a credit to the existing account and invoice the net difference — whichever you prefer.
- For EU B2B customers with a valid VAT ID, we apply the reverse-charge (zero VAT on our invoice) and include the reverse-charge note and your VAT number on the invoice.
- Payment: we can accept SEPA bank transfer (preferred) or card on file. If your AP team requires the PO number on the invoice line, we will include it.

I've attached a preliminary estimate for the prorated charge so procurement can include it in their approval. Kimberly and Marcus — can you confirm the exact prorate factor and which invoice path (short invoice vs. credit+invoice) we should take for ArgenBio?

Hi all — matching internal calc here. Summary:

- Monthly seat price (per seat): EUR 1,200/mo (as per SOW)
- Seats added: 10
- Billing period remaining: 27 days (4–30 July inclusive) out of 31-day month = prorate factor 27/31 = 0.870967 -> rounded to 0.871
- Prorated unit charge: EUR 1,200 * 0.871 = EUR 1,045.20 -> x10 seats = EUR 10,452.00
- Taxes: ArgenBio provided VAT ID IT12345678901 and is EU B2B. Apply reverse-charge; issue invoice net EUR 10,452.00 with reverse-charge note (no VAT charged).

Recommendation: issue a short (standalone) prorated invoice referencing PO#4521. This keeps recognition and collection separate and simplifies AP matching. If procurement asks for the delta to be credited against an upcoming invoice instead, we can credit.

I'll prepare the revised invoice draft and route to collections team for immediate issuance. Marcus — can you confirm SEPA details and that collections will accept the invoice with reverse-charge?

Thanks,
